svg.text: Our weekend plans are still up in the air.
Use still up in the air for an undecided
outcome or arrangement. It does not mean
A: Have you decided where to go this
B: Our plans are still up in the air.
A: What are you waiting for?
B: The weather forecast. Then we can
Name an undecided plan and what would
settle it. Model: The venue is up in the air
until we know how many guests are coming.
